title: 応用バイオ専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Applied Bioscience Major Lab/Exercises A
keywords: Planning, practice, presentation 2.Scientific observation 3.Testing a hypothesis 4.Scientific reports
educationalGoal: Student will: acquire scientific insight through basic lectures and exercises learn how to write scientific reports; learn the logical considerations for methods, results, and discussion; and learn presentation techniques. The goal of this course is to introduce life science students to the skills of observation and enquiry.
advice: Student will work under the following three themes to acquire information and learn experimental techniques for "sensory function", "behavioral principles" and "microbiological production technology". (1) Human visual function - Stereo vision and eye movement (2) Neuronal mechanism controlling instinctive behavior in insects (3) Microbiological production with fermentation and microbial transformation
requiredKnowledge: (1) Expertise acquired via related lectures (2) Reading of distributed text materials

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the basic characteristics of stereo vision and eye movement in humans.
Ability to explain human behavior and its neural mechanism.
Ability to explain the characteristics of fermentation and microbial transformation.
Ability to consider whether results are suited to theory.
Ability to present the contents of experiments.
Ability to write experiment reports and comprehension of aim, methods, results, and discussion.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
